label: LightGBM chosen config, same hyperparameters, three different row orders
hyperparameters_source: frozen_model_config.json lightgbm_chosen.hyperparameters (num_leaves=15, learning_rate=0.08, min_child_samples=1500, feature_fraction=0.6, bagging_fraction=0.8, lambda_l1=0.1, lambda_l2=1.0)
cause: LightGBM's seeded bagging_fraction/feature_fraction subsampling selects rows by physical position, not by a stable key (id), so the same seed samples different rows under a different row order - see src/models/diagnose_row_order_bagging.py

frozen_original_pipeline_order.note: the already-committed, frozen number - the row order produced by the pipeline before the 2026-11-10 ORDER BY fix

conclusion: Row order alone moves this config's validation AUC by about 0.0007 - small in absolute terms, but enough that a full ~40-trial tuning search's best-vs-chosen selection rule (within 0.002 AUC tolerance) can pick an entirely different trial when row order changes, which is what happened when gbm.py was rerun after the ORDER BY fix (chosen n_trees 273 -> 232, calibration method platt -> isotonic).
